cards.mouth: YOUR MAN, WHEN ONE OF YOURS DROPS
THE ENEMY'S LEADER, AT YOUR PLACE
cards.in_the_file: Your place has what we need, so we came to take it.
cards.line: Your place has what we need, so we came to take it.

cards.mouth: A JOB GIVER AT THE BOARD
cards.in_the_file: Tito drank a month on my tab and moved across the wash. Bring back what he owes, however you do it, and {pay} batteries.
cards.line: Tito drank a month on my tab and moved across the wash. Bring back what he owes, however you do it, and 33 batteries.

cards.who: A GIRL IN A STORM DRAIN
cards.in_the_file: ¡Aquí abajo! My foot is stuck in the grate. The water comes when it rains, and it's going to rain. Please.
cards.line: ¡Aquí abajo! My foot is stuck in the grate. The water comes when it rains, and it's going to rain. Please.

cards.in_the_file: {name}'s share splits between us now. Sad. Lucrative.
cards.line: TEO's share splits between us now. Sad. Lucrative.

cards.in_the_file: The kitchen is open again, mijo. The whole strip eats tonight, not only his crew.
cards.line: The kitchen is open again, mijo. The whole strip eats tonight, not only his crew.

cards.mouth: A JOB GIVER AT THE BOARD
cards.in_the_file: A sealed letter goes to the council over the pass, signed for inside six days. Do not read it, the seal is the receipt, and {pay} batteries wait for you when they sign.
cards.line: A sealed letter goes to the council over the pass, signed for inside six days. Do not read it, the seal is the receipt, and 23 batteries wait for you when they sign.

cards.mouth: A SIDE QUEST ON THE ROAD
cards.in_the_file: Poles, blanket, two men, ten minutes. It's clean, it's public, and it's the correct way to do a thing you don't want to feel.
cards.line: Poles, blanket, two men, ten minutes. It's clean, it's public, and it's the correct way to do a thing you don't want to feel.

cards.in_the_file: Good evening. Messages from family abroad may be delayed. Family abroad is safe. Thank you for your patience.
cards.line: Good evening. Messages from family abroad may be delayed. Family abroad is safe. Thank you for your patience.

cards.in_the_file: Their tailoring was a crime. Justice served.
cards.line: Their tailoring was a crime. Justice served.

cards.in_the_file: That's the toll. Paid in full.
cards.line: That's the toll. Paid in full.

cards.mouth: A JOB GIVER AT THE BOARD
cards.in_the_file: The lab grew one ground sloth and it walked home to Tule Springs, where its bones were found, and now it flattens tents. Put it down and it pays {pay} batteries.
cards.line: The lab grew one ground sloth and it walked home to Tule Springs, where its bones were found, and now it flattens tents. Put it down and it pays 95 batteries.
